why: herdr 0.8.0's recorded behavior, one verdict per fact, taken before herdr left the repository. Each fact is pinned to the test that holds muster-daemon to the same behavior, says how Muster deliberately differs, or is marked as describing only herdr's own API or implementation. crates/muster-daemon/tests/migration.rs fails when a fact has no verdict, when a verdict names a fact that is gone, and when a pinned test no longer exists.

trimmed_rows_are_the_blank_remainder_of_.differs: A muster-daemon read trims no rows, so there is no remainder to account for (screen.rs::a_page_has_a_line_for_every_row_even_a_blank_one).

unknown_offset_key_is_accepted_and_ignor.differs: A read takes the absolute row to start from, so paging is part of the request rather than a key a client has to guess at.

bytes_a_bare_pty_carried.herdr_only: The probe's control: a pty with no daemon anywhere near it, measuring the kernel's MAX_CANON.

bytes_a_canonical_mode_reader_received.herdr_only: The kernel's MAX_CANON as herdr's send_text reached it; canonical_reader_matches_bare_pty is the claim that carries over.

send_text_fences_a_paste.differs: muster-daemon has one verb for sending text, and it always goes as a paste, fenced when the program asked for bracketed paste (typing.rs::sent_text_goes_as_a_paste_and_is_submitted_with_a_return).

snapshot_counts.herdr_only: Counts of the entities in herdr's session.snapshot, workspaces and agents among them.

snapshot_live_fields_present.herdr_only: Key names on herdr's pane object in a snapshot.

snapshot_pane_keys.herdr_only: Key names on herdr's pane object in a snapshot.

subscribe_replay_event_kinds.herdr_only: herdr's own event names and their spelling; muster-daemon's events are protobuf messages with no string names.

subscribe_replays_existing_state.differs: Subscribing answers with a snapshot and then only later events, so nothing from before it is replayed (subscribing.rs::a_subscription_starts_from_its_snapshot_and_hears_only_what_follows).

arrangements_published_across_the_pair.differs: A pane goes on any of four sides in one request, so a left split publishes one arrangement rather than a split and a swap (panes.rs::a_pane_goes_on_the_side_asked_and_its_neighbour_keeps_the_share_asked).

arrival_gaps_ms.herdr_only: herdr's broadcast pacing, which delivers one event per kind per 100 ms.

event_arrival_ms.herdr_only: herdr's broadcast pacing, which delivers one event per kind per 100 ms.

pair_answered_in_ms.herdr_only: herdr's time to answer its split and swap requests.

pair_event_kinds.differs: A split on any side is one request, announced as pane_opened and then one tab_changed (subscribing.rs::a_subscription_starts_from_its_snapshot_and_hears_only_what_follows).

split_then_swap_answered_ms.herdr_only: herdr's time to answer its split and swap requests.

swap_answer_arrangement.herdr_only: The layout in herdr's pane.swap answer.

swap_answers_with_a_layout.differs: A muster-daemon swap answers with an outcome only; on a subscribed connection the tab's new record arrives as tab_changed before that answer.

swap_focused_pane.differs: muster-daemon holds no focus and has no focus request: which pane the keyboard is on is each window's own, and Muster never routes input by a daemon's cursor (docs/mip/0003-own-daemon.md).

swap_reason.herdr_only: The reason field in herdr's pane.swap answer.

swap_with_no_target.herdr_only: herdr's error for a pane.swap missing a field; a muster-daemon swap names both panes, and one that is not there answers NOT_THERE.
